questions.text: sin⁻¹(sin(−10π/3)) का मुख्य मान है :
questions.text_english: The principal value of sin⁻¹(sin(−10π/3)) is :
questions.solution: We need sin⁻¹(sin(−10π/3)). First, simplify the angle: −10π/3 = −4π + 2π/3, so sin(−10π/3) = sin(2π/3) = sin(π − π/3) = sin(π/3). Now sin⁻¹(sin(π/3)) = π/3, but we must check: actually −10π/3 = −4π + 2π/3, giving sin(2π/3) = √3/2. Since the principal range of sin⁻¹ is [−π/2, π/2] and sin(π/3) = √3/2, we get sin⁻¹(√3/2) = π/3. But let us re-check: −10π/3 + 4π = 2π/3. sin(2π/3) = sin(π − π/3) = sin(π/3). So the answer is sin⁻¹(sin(π/3)) = π/3. However, re-examining: −10π/3 = −3π − π/3, so sin(−10π/3) = sin(−3π−π/3) = sin(−π − π/3 − 2π) = −sin(π+π/3−2π)... Using −10π/3: divide by 2π gives quotient −2 remainder 2π/3, so sin(−10π/3)=sin(2π/3)=√3/2. Principal value of sin⁻¹(√3/2) = π/3. But option (B) is −π/3. Re-check: −10π/3 = −4π+2π/3. Actually −4π+2π/3: sin = sin(2π/3)=√3/2, so sin⁻¹=π/3. The correct answer is (C) π/3. Option C is correct because sin(−10π/3) = sin(2π/3) = √3/2 and the principal value of sin⁻¹(√3/2) lies in [−π/2, π/2], giving π/3. Options A, B, and D are outside the principal value range consideration for this value.
questions.topic: Principal Value of Inverse Trigonometric Functions

questions.text: यदि A तथा B समान कोटि के वर्ग आव्यूह हैं तथा AB = A तथा BA = B है, तो A² + B² बराबर है :
questions.text_english: If A and B are square matrices of same order such that AB = A and BA = B, then A² + B² is equal to :
questions.solution: Given AB = A and BA = B. We compute A² = A·A = (AB)A = A(BA) = AB = A. Similarly B² = B·B = (BA)B = B(AB) = BA = B. Therefore A² + B² = A + B. Option (A) is correct. Option (B) BA = B ≠ A+B in general; option (C) 2(A+B) is double the correct value; option (D) 2BA = 2B ≠ A+B in general.

questions.text: माना वास्तविक x के लिए, f(x) = x³ + 5x + 1 है, तो :
questions.text_english: For real x, let f(x) = x³ + 5x + 1. Then :

options.A: f, R पर एकैकी है लेकिन आच्छादक नहीं है
options.B: f, R पर आच्छादक है लेकिन एकैकी नहीं है
options.C: f, R पर एकैकी और आच्छादक है
options.D: f, R पर न तो एकैकी है और न ही आच्छादक

options_english.A: f is one-one but not onto on R
options_english.B: f is onto on R but not one-one
options_english.C: f is one-one and onto on R
options_english.D: f is neither one-one nor onto on R

questions.solution: f(x) = x³ + 5x + 1. Differentiating: f'(x) = 3x² + 5 > 0 for all real x, since 3x² ≥ 0 and 5 > 0. Thus f is strictly increasing on R, which means f is one-one (injective). Since f is a continuous, strictly increasing function from R to R and approaches −∞ as x→−∞ and +∞ as x→+∞, by the intermediate value theorem, f takes every real value, so f is onto (surjective). Hence f is bijective. Option (C) is correct.

questions.text: यदि y = sin⁻¹ x है, तो (1 − x²) d²y/dx² बराबर है :
questions.text_english: If y = sin⁻¹ x, then (1 − x²) d²y/dx² is equal to :
questions.solution: If y = sin⁻¹x, then dy/dx = 1/√(1−x²). Differentiating again: d²y/dx² = x/(1−x²)^(3/2). Therefore (1−x²) d²y/dx² = x/(1−x²)^(1/2) = x · [1/√(1−x²)] = x dy/dx. Option (A) is correct. Options (B), (C), and (D) differ by sign or power of x.

questions.text: λ के वे मान जिनके लिए f(x) = sin x − cos x − λx + C, x के सभी वास्तविक मानों के लिए ह्रासमान है, हैं :
questions.text_english: The values of λ so that f(x) = sin x − cos x − λx + C decreases for all real values of x are :
questions.solution: For f(x) to be decreasing for all real x, we need f'(x) ≤ 0 for all x. f'(x) = cos x + sin x − λ. The maximum value of cos x + sin x is √2. So for f'(x) ≤ 0 for all x, we need λ ≥ √2. Option (C) is correct. Option (A) gives an upper bound less than √2, which is insufficient; option (B) λ ≥ 1 is too weak since the maximum of cos x+sin x is √2 > 1; option (D) λ < 1 would allow f to increase.

questions.text: बिंदुओं (3, 6, −1) तथा (6, 2, −2) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड पर एक बिंदु P एसा है कि इसका y-निर्देशांक 4 है, तो इसका z-निर्देशांक है :
questions.text_english: If P is a point on the line segment joining (3, 6, −1) and (6, 2, −2) and y-coordinate of P is 4, then its z-coordinate is :
questions.solution: A point on the segment joining (3,6,−1) and (6,2,−2) can be written as P = (3+3t, 6−4t, −1−t) for t ∈ [0,1]. Given y-coordinate = 4: 6−4t = 4 ⇒ t = 1/2. Substituting in z: z = −1 − 1/2 = −3/2. Option (A) is correct.

questions.text: यदि M तथा N कोटि 3 के एसे वर्ग आव्यूह हैं कि det (M) = m तथा MN = mI है, तो det (N) बराबर है :
questions.text_english: If M and N are square matrices of order 3 such that det (M) = m and MN = mI, then det (N) is equal to :
questions.solution: Given MN = mI. Taking determinants on both sides: det(M) · det(N) = det(mI) = m³ (since det(mI) = m³ for a 3×3 matrix). We have det(M) = m, so m · det(N) = m³, giving det(N) = m². Option (D) is correct. Options (A) and (B) are constant values independent of m, which is incorrect; option (C) has a wrong sign.

questions.text_english: If f(x) = {3x−2, 0<x≤1; 2x²+ax, 1<x<2} is continuous for x∈(0,2), then a is equal to :
questions.solution: For continuity at x = 1, the left-hand limit must equal the right-hand limit. LHL = 3(1)−2 = 1. RHL = lim(x→1⁺)(2x²+ax) = 2(1)+a = 2+a. Setting LHL = RHL: 1 = 2+a, so a = −1. Option (D) is correct. Options (A), (B), and (C) give values of a that do not satisfy the continuity condition at x=1.

questions.text: यदि f : N → W, f(n) = {n/2, यदि n सम है; 0, यदि n विषम है} द्वारा परिभाषित है, तो f :
questions.text_english: If f : N → W is defined as f(n) = {n/2, if n is even; 0, if n is odd}, then f is :

options.D: न तो आच्छादी है और न ही एकैकी

questions.solution: f(n) = n/2 if n is even, and f(n) = 0 if n is odd. The function is not injective because f(1) = 0 and f(3) = 0 (any two odd numbers map to 0). However, every non-negative integer w ∈ W has a preimage: w = 0 has preimage 1 (odd), and any w > 0 has preimage 2w (even). So f is surjective (onto). Hence f is surjective only. Option (B) is correct.

Let A = [[0,1,−2],[−1,0,−7],[2,7,0]]. We check if Aᵀ = −A. The transpose Aᵀ = [[0,−1,2],[1,0,7],[−2,−7,0]] = −A. Since Aᵀ = −A and all diagonal elements are 0, A is a skew-symmetric matrix. Option (C) is correct. It is not diagonal (non-zero off-diagonal entries), not symmetric (A ≠ Aᵀ), and not a scalar matrix.

questions.text: यदि Δ ABC की भुजाएँ AB तथा AC क्रमशः सिदिशों ĵ + k̂ तथा 3î − ĵ + 4k̂ द्वारा निरूपित हैं, तो A से BC पर खींची गई माध्यिका की लंबाई है :
questions.text_english: If the sides AB and AC of Δ ABC are represented by vectors ĵ + k̂ and 3î − ĵ + 4k̂ respectively, then the length of the median through A on BC is :
questions.solution: Let AB = ĵ + k̂ and AC = 3î − ĵ + 4k̂. The midpoint M of BC corresponds to the vector AM = (AB + AC)/2 = (3î + 0ĵ + 5k̂)/2 = (3/2)î + (5/2)k̂. The length of the median |AM| = √[(3/2)² + 0² + (5/2)²] = √[9/4 + 25/4] = √(34/4) = √34/2. Option (C) is correct.

questions.text: f(x) = {x, यदि x ≤ 1; 5, यदि x > 1} द्वारा परिभाषित फलन f संतत नहीं है :
questions.text_english: The function f defined by f(x) = {x, if x ≤ 1; 5, if x > 1} is not continuous at :
questions.solution: At x = 1: the left-hand limit is lim(x→1⁻) f(x) = 1, and the right-hand limit is lim(x→1⁺) f(x) = 5, and f(1) = 1. Since LHL ≠ RHL, f is not continuous at x = 1. At all other given points (x = 0, 2, 5), the function is continuous since it is either the identity or the constant 5 in a neighbourhood of those points. Option (B) is correct.

questions.text: यदि f(x) = 2x + cos x है, तो f(x) :
questions.text_english: If f(x) = 2x + cos x, then f(x) :

options.A: का x = π पर अधिकतम मान है
options.B: का x = π पर न्यूनतम मान है

options_english.A: has a maxima at x = π
options_english.B: has a minima at x = π

questions.solution: f'(x) = 2 − sin x. Since −1 ≤ sin x ≤ 1, we have f'(x) = 2 − sin x ≥ 2 − 1 = 1 > 0 for all x. Since f'(x) > 0 for all real x, f is strictly increasing everywhere. There is no maximum or minimum. Option (C) is correct. Options (A) and (B) are wrong as there are no extrema; option (D) is wrong since f'(x) > 0.

questions.text: ∫ (cos 2x − cos 2α)/(cos x − cos α) dx बराबर है :
questions.text_english: ∫ (cos 2x − cos 2α)/(cos x − cos α) dx is equal to :
questions.solution: Using the identity cos 2x − cos 2α = 2(cos²x − cos²α) = 2(cos x − cos α)(cos x + cos α), the integrand simplifies to 2(cos x + cos α). Integrating: ∫ 2(cos x + cos α) dx = 2 sin x + 2x cos α + C = 2(sin x + x cos α) + C. Option (A) is correct.

questions.text: ∫₀¹ dx/(eˣ + e⁻ˣ) का मान है :
questions.text_english: The value of ∫₀¹ dx/(eˣ + e⁻ˣ) is :
questions.solution: We write 1/(eˣ + e⁻ˣ) = eˣ/(e^(2x) + 1). Let u = eˣ, du = eˣ dx. When x = 0, u = 1; when x = 1, u = e. The integral becomes ∫₁ᵉ du/(1+u²) = [tan⁻¹ u]₁ᵉ = tan⁻¹ e − tan⁻¹ 1 = tan⁻¹ e − π/4. Option (C) is correct.

questions.text: अवकल समीकरण (d²y/dx²)² + (dy/dx)² = x sin(dy/dx) की कोटि तथा घात है :
questions.text_english: The order and degree of the differential equation (d²y/dx²)² + (dy/dx)² = x sin(dy/dx) are :
questions.solution: The highest order derivative present is d²y/dx², so the order is 2. The degree is the power of the highest order derivative after the equation is made polynomial in derivatives. However, the term sin(dy/dx) is a transcendental (non-polynomial) function of dy/dx, so the equation cannot be expressed as a polynomial in the derivatives. Hence the degree is not defined. Option (C) is correct.
questions.topic: Order and Degree of Differential Equations

questions.text: वक्र y = √x, रेखाओं x = 0 तथा x = 4 तथा x-अक्ष से घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल है :
questions.text_english: The area of the region enclosed by the curve y = √x and the lines x = 0 and x = 4 and x-axis is :

questions.text: एक रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या (LPP) के सुसंगत क्षेत्र के कोनीय बिंदु (0,2), (3,0), (6,0), (6,8) तथा (0,5) हैं। यदि उद्देश्य फलन Z = ax + by; (a,b > 0) का अधिकतम मान (0,2) तथा (3,0) पर प्राप्त होता है, तो a तथा b में संबंध है :
questions.text_english: The corner points of the feasible region of a Linear Programming Problem are (0,2), (3,0), (6,0), (6,8) and (0,5). If Z = ax + by; (a, b > 0) be the objective function, and maximum value of Z is obtained at (0,2) and (3,0), then the relation between a and b is :
questions.solution: If Z is maximum at both (0,2) and (3,0), then Z(0,2) = Z(3,0). Z(0,2) = a(0) + b(2) = 2b. Z(3,0) = a(3) + b(0) = 3a. Setting equal: 2b = 3a, i.e., 3a = 2b. Option (D) is correct.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : यदि A तथा B दो एसी घटनाएँ हैं कि P(A ∩ B) = 0 है, तो A तथा B स्वतंत्र घटनाएँ हैं।
तर्क (R) : दो घटनाएँ स्वतंत्र होती हैं यदि एक के घटने का दूसरे के घटने पर कोई प्रभाव न पड़े।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): If A and B are two events such that P(A ∩ B) = 0, then A and B are independent events.
Reason (R): Two events are independent if the occurrence of one does not effect the occurrence of the other.
questions.instruction_line: सही उत्तर चुनिए : (A) दोनों सही हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या है; (B) दोनों सही हैं पर R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है; (C) A सही है पर R गलत है; (D) A गलत है पर R सही है।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from codes (A), (B), (C) and (D): (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A; (B) Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A; (C) A is true, but R is false; (D) A is false, but R is true.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A)
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A)
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true

questions.solution: The Assertion (A) states that P(A ∩ B) = 0 implies A and B are independent. This is false. P(A ∩ B) = 0 means A and B are mutually exclusive (disjoint), not independent. Independence requires P(A ∩ B) = P(A)·P(B), which is not the same as P(A ∩ B) = 0 unless P(A) = 0 or P(B) = 0. The Reason (R) is the correct definition of independence and is true. Hence option (D) is correct: A is false but R is true.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : एक रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या (LPP) में यदि सुसंगत क्षेत्र खाली है, तो रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या (LPP) का कोई हल नहीं है।
तर्क (R) : सुसंगत क्षेत्र वह क्षेत्र है जिसमें सारे व्यवरोध संतुष्ट होते हैं।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): In a Linear Programming Problem, if the feasible region is empty, then the Linear Programming Problem has no solution.
Reason (R): A feasible region is defined as the region that satisfies all the constraints.
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from codes (A), (B), (C) and (D).

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A)
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A)
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is true: if the feasible region is empty (no point satisfies all constraints simultaneously), the LPP has no solution since there is no feasible point at which to optimize the objective function. Reason (R) is also true and it is the correct explanation of (A): the feasible region is the set of all points satisfying all constraints, and if it is empty, no solution exists. Option (A) is correct.

questions.text: माना A तथा B कोटि 3 के दो वर्ग आव्यूह हैं तथा det (A) = 3 तथा det (B) = − 4 है। det (− 6AB) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Let A and B be two square matrices of order 3 such that det (A) = 3 and det (B) = − 4. Find the value of det (− 6AB).
questions.solution: For a 3×3 matrix, det(kM) = k³ det(M). Therefore det(−6AB) = (−6)³ · det(A) · det(B) = −216 × 3 × (−4) = −216 × (−12) = 2592. Hence det(−6AB) = 2592.

questions.text:
(क) ‘a’ का वह न्यूनतम मान ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके लिए f(x) = 2x² − ax + 3; [2, 4] पर एक वर्धमान फलन हो।
अथवा
(ख) यदि f(x) = x + 1/x, x ≥ 1 है, तो दर्शाइए कि f एक वर्धमान फलन है।
questions.text_english:
(a) Find the least value of 'a' so that f(x) = 2x² − ax + 3 is an increasing function on [2, 4].
OR
(b) If f(x) = x + 1/x, x ≥ 1, show that f is an increasing function.

key_points: (a) f'(x) = 4x - a ≥ 0 on [2,4] requires a ≤ 4x for all x in [2,4]; minimum of 4x on [2,4] is 8, so a ≤ 8. Least value means the maximum a can be, which is 8.

questions.solution:
(a) f(x) = 2x² − ax + 3. For f to be increasing on [2, 4], we need f'(x) ≥ 0 for all x ∈ [2, 4]. f'(x) = 4x − a. For f'(x) ≥ 0, we need a ≤ 4x for all x ∈ [2, 4]. The minimum value of 4x on [2, 4] is 4(2) = 8. So we need a ≤ 8. The least (maximum permissible) value of 'a' for which f is increasing on the entire interval [2, 4] is a = 8.

(b) f(x) = x + 1/x for x ≥ 1. Then f'(x) = 1 − 1/x² = (x² − 1)/x². For x ≥ 1, x² ≥ 1, so x² − 1 ≥ 0 and x² > 0. Thus f'(x) ≥ 0 for all x ≥ 1, which means f is an increasing function.

questions.text:
(क) sin⁻¹(x/√(1+x²)) को सरलतम रूप में लिखिए।
अथवा
(ख) sin⁻¹√(x−1) का प्रांत ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Simplify sin⁻¹(x/√(1+x²)).
OR
(b) Find domain of sin⁻¹√(x−1).
questions.solution:
(a) Let x = tanθ, so θ = tan⁻¹x. Then x/√(1+x²) = tanθ/√(1+tan²θ) = tanθ/secθ = sinθ. Therefore sin⁻¹(x/√(1+x²)) = sin⁻¹(sinθ) = θ = tan⁻¹ x.

(b) For sin⁻¹√(x−1) to be defined, we need −1 ≤ √(x−1) ≤ 1. Since √(x−1) ≥ 0 always, the condition reduces to 0 ≤ √(x−1) ≤ 1. Squaring: 0 ≤ x−1 ≤ 1, giving 1 ≤ x ≤ 2. The domain is [1, 2].
questions.topic: Simplification and Domain of Inverse Trig Functions

questions.text: समाकलन के प्रयोग से, वक्र x²/9 + y²/4 = 1 तथा x-अक्ष के बीच घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल परिकलित कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Calculate the area of the region bounded by the curve x²/9 + y²/4 = 1 and the x-axis using integration.

key_points: Area = 3π sq. units (upper half of ellipse)

questions.solution: The ellipse x²/9 + y²/4 = 1 has semi-axes a = 3 (along x) and b = 2 (along y). The area of the region bounded by the ellipse and the x-axis (upper half) is: Area = ∫₋³³ y dx = ∫₋³³ (2/3)√(9−x²) dx = (2/3)×(1/2)π(3)² = (2/3)×(9π/2) = 3π. Therefore the area is 3π square units.

questions.text: वक्र y = 5x − 2x³ के लिए यदि x, 2 इकाई/सेकंड की दर से बढ़ रहा है, तो x = 2 पर वक्र की प्रवणता (ढाल) के बदलने की दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: For the curve y = 5x − 2x³, if x increases at the rate of 2 units/s, then how fast is the slope of the curve changing when x = 2?

key_points: Rate of change of slope = -48 units/s

questions.solution: The slope of the curve is dy/dx = 5 − 6x². The rate of change of slope with respect to time is d/dt(dy/dx) = −12x (dx/dt). Given dx/dt = 2 units/s and x = 2: d/dt(dy/dx) = −12(2)(2) = −48. The slope of the curve is decreasing at the rate of 48 units per second when x = 2.

questions.text:
(क) यदि f : R⁺ → R, f(x) = logₐ x (a > 0 तथा a ≠ 1) द्वारा परिभाषित है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि f एक एकैकी-आच्छादक फलन है। (R⁺ सभी धनात्मक वास्तविक संख्याओं का समुच्चय है।)
अथवा
(ख) माना A = {1, 2, 3} तथा B = {4, 5, 6}। A से B में एक संबंध R इस प्रकार परिभाषित है कि R = {(x, y) : x + y = 6, x ∈ A, y ∈ B} है। (i) R के सभी अवयव लिखिए। (ii) क्या R एक फलन है ? सत्यापित कीजिए। (iii) R का प्रांत व परिसर ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) If f : R⁺ → R is defined as f(x) = logₐ x (a > 0 and a ≠ 1), prove that f is a bijection. (R⁺ is a set of all positive real numbers.)
OR
(b) Let A = {1, 2, 3} and B = {4, 5, 6}. A relation R from A to B is defined as R = {(x, y) : x + y = 6, x ∈ A, y ∈ B}. (i) Write all elements of R. (ii) Is R a function? Justify. (iii) Determine domain and range of R.

key_points: (a) One-one: logₐx₁=logₐx₂ implies x₁=x₂; Onto: for every y∈R, x=a^y∈R⁺ maps to y.

questions.solution:
(a) One-one: Let f(x₁) = f(x₂), i.e., logₐ x₁ = logₐ x₂. Since logarithm is one-to-one, x₁ = x₂. Hence f is injective. Onto: For any y ∈ R, choose x = aʸ ∈ R⁺. Then f(x) = logₐ(aʸ) = y. Every real number has a preimage in R⁺. Hence f is surjective. Since f is both one-one and onto, it is a bijection.

(b) (i) R = {(x,y): x+y=6, x∈{1,2,3}, y∈{4,5,6}}. Checking: 1+5=6 (y=5∈B), 2+4=6 (y=4∈B), 3+3=6 (y=3∉B since B={4,5,6}). So R = {(1,5),(2,4)}. Wait: B={4,5,6}, so y=3∉B; R={(1,5),(2,4)}. (ii) R is a function since every element of the domain {1,2} has a unique image. However, 3∈A has no image (3+y=6⇒y=3∉B), so R is not a function from A to B (it is not defined for all elements of A). (iii) Domain of R = {1, 2}, Range of R = {5, 4} = {4, 5}.

questions.text:
(क) यदि फलन f(x) = {(x²−2x−3)/(x+1), x≠−1; k, x=−1} x = − 1 पर संतत है, तो k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) फलन f(x) = x|x| की x = 0 पर अवकलनीयता की जाँच कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Find k so that f(x) = {(x²−2x−3)/(x+1), x≠−1; k, x=−1} is continuous at x = − 1.
OR
(b) Check the differentiability of function f(x) = x|x| at x = 0.

key_points: (b) f is differentiable at x=0 with f'(0) = 0

questions.solution:
(a) For f to be continuous at x = −1, we need lim(x→−1) f(x) = k. We factor the numerator: x²−2x−3 = (x−3)(x+1). So for x≠−1: f(x) = (x−3)(x+1)/(x+1) = x−3. Thus lim(x→−1) f(x) = −1−3 = −4. For continuity, k = −4.

(b) f(x) = x|x|. For x > 0: f(x) = x²; for x < 0: f(x) = −x². LHD at x=0: lim(h→0⁻) [f(h)−f(0)]/h = lim(h→0⁻) (−h²)/h = lim −h = 0. RHD at x=0: lim(h→0⁺) [f(h)−f(0)]/h = lim(h→0⁺) h²/h = lim h = 0. Since LHD = RHD = 0, f is differentiable at x = 0 and f'(0) = 0.

questions.text: मान ज्ञात कीजिए : ∫_{π/2}^{π} eˣ × ((1−sin x)/(1−cos x)) dx
questions.text_english: Evaluate : ∫_{π/2}^{π} eˣ × ((1−sin x)/(1−cos x)) dx

key_points: The integral evaluates to e^π cot(π/2) - e^(π/2) cot(π/4), using the formula ∫ e^x[f(x)+f'(x)]dx = e^x f(x) + C

questions.solution: We write (1−sin x)/(1−cos x) = 1/(1−cos x) − sin x/(1−cos x). Using half-angle identities: 1−cos x = 2sin²(x/2) and sin x = 2sin(x/2)cos(x/2). So (1−sin x)/(1−cos x) = 1/(2sin²(x/2)) − cos(x/2)/sin(x/2) = (1/2)cosec²(x/2) − cot(x/2). We use the standard result ∫ eˣ[f(x)+f'(x)]dx = eˣ f(x)+C. Let f(x) = −cot(x/2), then f'(x) = (1/2)cosec²(x/2). So the integrand is eˣ[f'(x)+f(x)... wait: f'(x)=(1/2)cosec²(x/2) and f(x)=−cot(x/2). Thus eˣ[(1/2)cosec²(x/2)−cot(x/2)] = eˣ[f'(x)+f(x)]. The integral = [eˣ f(x)]₋{π/2}^{π} = [eˣ(−cot(x/2))]₋{π/2}^{π} = e^π(−cot(π/2)) − e^(π/2)(−cot(π/4)) = e^π(0)+e^(π/2)(1) = e^(π/2).

questions.text:
(क) तीन बच्चों वाले परिवारों में लड़कों की संख्या का प्रायिकता बंटन ज्ञात कीजिए, यह मानते हुए कि लड़का व लड़की के होने की प्रायिकता समान है।
अथवा
(ख) एक सिक्का दो बार उछाला गया। माना एक यादृच्छिक चर X = चितों की संख्या − पटों की संख्या द्वारा परिभाषित किया गया है। X का प्रायिकता बंटन ज्ञात कीजिए तथा इसका माध्य भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Find the probability distribution of the number of boys in families having three children, assuming equal probability for a boy and a girl.
OR
(b) A coin is tossed twice. Let X be a random variable defined as number of heads minus number of tails. Obtain the probability distribution of X and also find its mean.

key_points: (b) X takes values -2,0,2 with P=1/4,1/2,1/4; Mean=0

questions.solution:
(a) Let X = number of boys. Each child is a boy or girl with equal probability 1/2. X ~ B(3, 1/2). P(X=0) = C(3,0)(1/2)³ = 1/8. P(X=1) = C(3,1)(1/2)³ = 3/8. P(X=2) = C(3,2)(1/2)³ = 3/8. P(X=3) = C(3,3)(1/2)³ = 1/8.

(b) When a coin is tossed twice, sample space = {HH, HT, TH, TT}. X = heads − tails. For HH: X = 2−0 = 2. For HT or TH: X = 1−1 = 0. For TT: X = 0−2 = −2. So P(X=2) = 1/4, P(X=0) = 2/4 = 1/2, P(X=−2) = 1/4. Mean E(X) = 2(1/4) + 0(1/2) + (−2)(1/4) = 1/2 + 0 − 1/2 = 0.

questions.text_english: Find the distance of the point (−1, −5, −10) from the point of intersection of the lines (x−1)/2 = (y−2)/3 = (z−3)/4 and (x−4)/5 = (y−1)/2 = z.
questions.solution: Line 1: (x−1)/2 = (y−2)/3 = (z−3)/4 = λ gives point (2λ+1, 3λ+2, 4λ+3). Line 2: (x−4)/5 = (y−1)/2 = z = μ gives point (5μ+4, 2μ+1, μ). Setting equal: 2λ+1 = 5μ+4, 3λ+2 = 2μ+1, 4λ+3 = μ. From the third equation: μ = 4λ+3. Substituting in the second: 3λ+2 = 2(4λ+3)+1 = 8λ+7, giving −5λ = 5, so λ = −1 and μ = 4(−1)+3 = −1. Intersection point: (2(−1)+1, 3(−1)+2, 4(−1)+3) = (−1, −1, −1). Verify with Line 2: (5(−1)+4, 2(−1)+1, −1) = (−1, −1, −1). ✔ Distance from (−1,−1,−1) to (−1,−5,−10): d = √[(0)²+(−4)²+(−9)²] = √[0+16+81] = √97. So the distance is √97 units.

questions.text: ग्राफीय विधि द्वारा निम्नलिखित रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या हल कीजिए : Z = 100x + 50y का अधिकतमीकरण करना, निम्न व्यवरोधों के अंतर्गत: 3x + y ≤ 600, x + y ≤ 300, y ≤ x + 200, x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0
questions.text_english: Solve the following Linear Programming Problem using graphical method: Maximise Z = 100x + 50y subject to the constraints: 3x + y ≤ 600, x + y ≤ 300, y ≤ x + 200, x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0

key_points: Z is maximum at (150,150) giving Z=22500

questions.text: यदि A एक 3 × 3 व्युत्क्रमणीय आव्यूह है, तो दर्शाइए कि किसी अदिश k ≠ 0 के लिए (kA)⁻¹ = (1/k) A⁻¹। अत: (3A)⁻¹ परिकलित कीजिए, जहाँ A = [[2,−1,1],[−1,2,−1],[1,−1,2]]।
questions.text_english: If A is a 3 × 3 invertible matrix, show that for any scalar k ≠ 0, (kA)⁻¹ = (1/k) A⁻¹. Hence calculate (3A)⁻¹, where A = [[2,−1,1],[−1,2,−1],[1,−1,2]].

questions.text: सूर्य के प्रकाश के संपर्क में आने के सापेक्ष पौधे की ऊँचाई (y सेमी) के बीच का संबंध समीकरण y = 4x − (1/2)x² द्वारा नियंत्रित होता है, जहाँ x सूर्य के प्रकाश के संपर्क में आने वाले दिनों की संख्या है। (i) सूर्य के प्रकाश के सापेक्ष पौधे की वृद्धि दर ज्ञात कीजिए। (ii) कितने दिनों में पौधा अपनी अधिकतम ऊँचाई प्राप्त कर लेगा ? अधिकतम ऊँचाई कितनी है ?
questions.text_english: The relation between the height of the plant (y cm) with respect to exposure to sunlight is governed by the equation y = 4x − (1/2)x², where x is the number of days exposed to sunlight. (i) Find the rate of growth of the plant with respect to sunlight. (ii) In how many days will the plant attain its maximum height? What is the maximum height?

sub_questions.text: सूर्य के प्रकाश के सापेक्ष पौधे की वृद्धि दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the rate of growth of the plant with respect to sunlight.
sub_questions.solution: The rate of growth of the plant with respect to sunlight exposure is dy/dx = 4 − x.

sub_questions.text: कितने दिनों में पौधा अपनी अधिकतम ऊँचाई प्राप्त कर लेगा ? अधिकतम ऊँचाई कितनी है ?
sub_questions.text_english: In how many days will the plant attain its maximum height? What is the maximum height?
sub_questions.solution: For maximum height, set dy/dx = 0: 4 − x = 0, so x = 4 days. d²y/dx² = −1 < 0, confirming a maximum. Maximum height y = 4(4) − (1/2)(4)² = 16 − 8 = 8 cm.

questions.solution: See sub-questions for detailed solutions.

questions.text:
(क) ज्ञात कीजिए : ∫ cos x / [(4 + sin²x)(5 − 4cos²x)] dx
अथवा
(ख) मान ज्ञात कीजिए : ∫₀^{π} dx / (a²cos²x + b²sin²x)
questions.text_english:
(a) Find : ∫ cos x / [(4 + sin²x)(5 − 4cos²x)] dx
OR
(b) Evaluate : ∫₀^{π} dx / (a²cos²x + b²sin²x)

key_points: (a) Use substitution t = sin x; partial fractions on 1/[(4+t²)(4t²-1)] -- actually 5-4cos²x = 4sin²x+1

questions.solution:
(a) Let t = sin x, dt = cos x dx. Also 5−4cos²x = 5−4(1−sin²x) = 4sin²x+1 = 4t²+1. The integral becomes ∫ dt/[(4+t²)(4t²+1)]. Using partial fractions: 1/[(4+t²)(4t²+1)] = A/(4+t²) + B/(4t²+1). Multiplying: 1 = A(4t²+1) + B(4+t²). Setting t² = −4: 1 = A(−15), so A = −1/15. Setting t² = −1/4: 1 = B(15/4), so B = 4/15. Integral = (−1/15)∫ dt/(4+t²) + (4/15)∫ dt/(4t²+1) = (−1/15)(1/2)tan⁻¹(t/2) + (4/15)(1/2)tan⁻¹(2t) + C = (−1/30)tan⁻¹(sin x/2) + (2/15)tan⁻¹(2 sin x) + C.

(b) I = ∫₀^{π} dx/(a²cos²x + b²sin²x). Dividing numerator and denominator by cos²x: I = ∫₀^{π} sec²x dx/(a² + b²tan²x). Using the property for symmetric integrals: I = 2∫₀^{π/2} sec²x dx/(a² + b²tan²x). Let t = tan x, dt = sec²x dx: I = 2∫₀^{∞} dt/(a² + b²t²) = (2/b²)∫₀^{∞} dt/(a²/b² + t²) = (2/b²)×(b/a)×[tan⁻¹(bt/a)]₀^{∞} = (2/ab)(π/2) = π/(ab).
questions.topic: Integration by Partial Fractions and Definite Integrals

questions.text:
(क) दर्शाइए कि एक समांतर चतुर्भुज जिसके विकर्ण वेक्तर वेक्तर a तथा वेक्तर b द्वारा निरूपित हों, का क्षेत्रफल (1/2)|a × b| द्वारा प्रदत्त होता है। अत: उस समांतर चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके विकर्ण 2î − ĵ + k̂ तथा î + 3ĵ − k̂ द्वारा प्रदत्त हैं।
अथवा
(ख) एक रेखा का सिदिश तथा कार्तीय समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए जो बिंदु (1, 2, − 4) से होकर जाती है तथा दोनों रेखाओं (x−8)/3 = (y+19)/(−16) = (z−10)/7 तथा r̅ = 15î + 29ĵ + 5k̂ + μ(3î + 8ĵ − 5k̂) के लंबवत है।
questions.text_english:
(a) Show that the area of a parallelogram whose diagonals are represented by vectors a and b is given by (1/2)|a × b|. Also find the area of a parallelogram whose diagonals are 2î − ĵ + k̂ and î + 3ĵ − k̂.
OR
(b) Find the equation of a line in vector and cartesian form which passes through the point (1, 2, −4) and is perpendicular to the lines (x−8)/3 = (y+19)/(−16) = (z−10)/7, and r̅ = 15î + 29ĵ + 5k̂ + μ(3î + 8ĵ − 5k̂).

key_points: (a) Area = (1/2)|a×b|; For given diagonals, a×b = (2i-j+k)×(i+3j-k); area = √110/2
(b) Direction of required line is perpendicular to both d₁=(3,-16,7) and d₂=(3,8,-5), so direction = d₁×d₂

questions.solution:
(a) If diagonals of a parallelogram are a and b, the sides are (a+b)/2 and (a−b)/2. Area = |(a+b)/2 × (a−b)/2| = (1/4)|a×a − a×b + b×a − b×b| = (1/4)|−a×b − a×b| (since a×a=0, b×b=0, b×a=−a×b) = (1/4)|2a×b| = (1/2)|a×b|. For a = 2î−ĵ+k̂ and b = î+3ĵ−k̂: a×b = |î ĵ k̂; 2 -1 1; 1 3 -1| = î((−1)(−1)−1·3)−ĵ(2(−1)−1·1)+k̂(2·3−(−1)·1) = î(1−3)−ĵ(−2−1)+k̂(6+1) = −2î+3ĵ+7k̂. |a×b| = √(4+9+49) = √62. Area = √62/2 sq. units.

(b) The required line is perpendicular to d₁ = (3,−16,7) and d₂ = (3,8,−5). Direction = d₁×d₂ = |î ĵ k̂; 3 -16 7; 3 8 -5| = î(80−56)−ĵ(−15−21)+k̂(24+48) = 24î+36ĵ+72k̂ = 12(2î+3ĵ+6k̂). Direction ratios: (2,3,6). Vector equation: r̅ = (î+2ĵ−4k̂) + λ(2î+3ĵ+6k̂). Cartesian equation: (x−1)/2 = (y−2)/3 = (z+4)/6.

questions.text:
कुछ छात्रों को दशमलवों की तुलना करते समय एक गलत धारणा होती है। उदाहरण के लिए, कोई छात्र 78.56 > 78.9 का उल्लेख कर सकता है क्योंकि 7856 > 789 है। इस अवधारणा का आकलन करने के लिए, अध्यापक द्वारा कक्षा VI के विद्यार्थियों को दशमलव तुलना परीक्षण के लिए निम्नलिखित प्रश्न दिया गया : हाल ही में स्कूल में आयोजित खेल दिवस में, 5 छात्रों ने भाला फेंक प्रतियोगिता में भाग लिया। उन्होंने जितनी दूरी तक भाला फेंका है, वह नीचे की तालिका में दर्शाया गया है :
छात्र का नाम | भाले की दूरी (मीटर में)
अजय | 47.7
बिजॉय | 47.07
कार्तिक | 43.09
दिनेश | 43.9
देवेश | 45.2
विद्यार्थियों से पूछा गया कि वे बताएँ कि भाला सबसे दूर किसने फेंका है। इस परीक्षा के आधार पर अध्यापक ने यह परिणाम प्राप्त किया कि 40% विद्यार्थियों को दशमलवों की तुलना में गलत धारणा है तथा शेष विद्यार्थियों को यह गलत धारणा नहीं है। परीक्षा में जिन विद्यार्थियों को यह गलत धारणा है, उनमें से 80% विद्यार्थियों ने बिजॉय को सही उत्तर के रूप में दिया जबकि जिन विद्यार्थियों को यह गलत धारणा नहीं है, उनमें से 90% ने अपना उत्तर बिजॉय नहीं दिया।
questions.text_english:
Some students are having a misconception while comparing decimals. For example, a student may mention that 78.56 > 78.9 as 7856 > 789. In order to assess this concept, a decimal comparison test was administered to the students of class VI through the following question: In the recently held Sports Day in the school, 5 students participated in a javelin throw competition. The distances to which they have thrown the javelin are shown below in the table:
Name of student | Distance of javelin (in meters)
Ajay | 47.7
Bijoy | 47.07
Kartik | 43.09
Dinesh | 43.9
Devesh | 45.2
The students were asked to identify who has thrown the javelin the farthest. Based on the test attempted by the students, the teacher concludes that 40% of the students have the misconception in the concept of decimal comparison and the rest do not have the misconception. 80% of the students having misconception answered Bijoy as the correct answer in the paper. 90% of the students who are identified with not having misconception, did not answer Bijoy as their answer.

On the basis of the above information, answer the following questions:
(i) What is the probability of a student not having misconception but still answers Bijoy in the test?
(ii) What is the probability that a randomly selected student answers Bijoy as his answer in the test?
(iii) (a) What is the probability that a student who answered as Bijoy is having misconception?
OR
(iii) (b) What is the probability that a student who answered as Bijoy is amongst students who do not have the misconception?

sub_questions.text: परीक्षा में एक विद्यार्थी जिसको यह गलत धारणा नहीं है, के बिजॉय, सही उत्तर के रूप में देने की प्रायिकता क्या है ?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the probability of a student not having misconception but still answers Bijoy in the test?
sub_questions.solution: Let M = misconception, M' = no misconception. P(M) = 0.4, P(M') = 0.6. P(Bijoy|M') = 1 − 0.9 = 0.1. P(no misconception and answers Bijoy) = P(M') × P(Bijoy|M') = 0.6 × 0.1 = 0.06.

sub_questions.text: इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि एक यादृच्छया चुना गया विद्यार्थी, परीक्षा में उत्तर के रूप में बिजॉय लिखता है ?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the probability that a randomly selected student answers Bijoy as his answer in the test?

sub_questions.text: (क) एक विद्यार्थी जिसने बिजॉय उत्तर के रूप में दिया, की गलत धारणा होने की क्या प्रायिकता है ?
sub_questions.text_english: (a) What is the probability that a student who answered as Bijoy is having misconception?

sub_questions.text: (ख) इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि एक विद्यार्थी जिसने अपना उत्तर बिजॉय दिया है, उन विद्यार्थियों में से है जिसे यह गलत धारणा नहीं है ?

questions.text: एक इंजीनियर एक शहर में नया मेट्रो रेल नेटवर्क डिज़ाइन कर रहा है। शुरू में, वह दो मेट्रो लाइनें A तथा B, विभिन्न स्टेशनों के लिए डिज़ाइन करता है। मेट्रो लाइन A का ट्रैक l₁ : (x−2)/3 = (y+1)/(−2) = (z−3)/4, जबकि लाइन B का ट्रैक l₂ : (x−1)/2 = (y−3)/1 = (z+2)/(−3) से निरूपित किया गया है।
questions.text_english:
An engineer is designing a new metro rail network in a city. Initially, two metro lines, Line A and Line B, each consisting of multiple stations are designed. The track for Line A is represented by l₁ : (x−2)/3 = (y+1)/(−2) = (z−3)/4, while the track for Line B is represented by l₂ : (x−1)/2 = (y−3)/1 = (z+2)/(−3).

Based on the above information, answer the following questions:
(i) Find whether the two metro tracks are parallel.
(ii) Solar panels are to be installed on the rooftop of the metro stations. Determine the equation of the line representing the placement of solar panels on the rooftop of Line A's stations, given that panels are to be positioned parallel to Line A's track (l₁) and pass through the point (1, −2, −3).
(iii) (a) To connect the stations, a pedestrian pathway perpendicular to the two metro lines is to be constructed which passes through point (3, 2, 1). Determine the equation of the pedestrian walkway.
OR
(iii) (b) Find the shortest distance between Line A and Line B.

sub_questions.text: ज्ञात कीजिए कि क्या दो मेट्रो ट्रैक परस्पर समांतर हैं।
sub_questions.text_english: Find whether the two metro tracks are parallel.

key_points: Direction ratios of l1=(3,-2,4) and l2=(2,1,-3) are not proportional, so lines are not parallel

sub_questions.solution: Direction ratios of l₁ are (3, −2, 4) and of l₂ are (2, 1, −3). For parallel lines, the ratios must be proportional: 3/2 ≠ −2/1. Since they are not proportional, the two metro tracks are not parallel.

sub_questions.text: मेट्रो लाइन A के स्टेशनों की छतों पर सोलर पैनल लगाए जाने हैं। लाइन A के ट्रैक (l₁) के समांतर तथा बिंदु (1, − 2, − 3) से हो कर जाने वाले सौर पैनलों को निरूपित करने वाली रेखा का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Determine the equation of the line representing the placement of solar panels on the rooftop of Line A's stations, given that panels are to be positioned parallel to Line A's track (l₁) and pass through the point (1, −2, −3).
sub_questions.solution: The solar panel line is parallel to l₁, so it has the same direction ratios (3, −2, 4) and passes through (1, −2, −3). The equation is (x−1)/3 = (y+2)/(−2) = (z+3)/4.

sub_questions.text: (क) स्टेशनों को जोड़ने के लिए, दोनों मेट्रो लाइनों के लंबवत एक पैदल यात्री पथ बनाना है जो बिंदु (3, 2, 1) से हो कर जाए। इस पैदल यात्री पथ का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) To connect the stations, a pedestrian pathway perpendicular to the two metro lines is to be constructed which passes through point (3, 2, 1). Determine the equation of the pedestrian walkway.
sub_questions.solution: The pathway is perpendicular to both l₁ and l₂, so its direction is d₁×d₂ where d₁=(3,-2,4) and d₂=(2,1,-3). d₁×d₂ = |î ĵ k̂; 3 -2 4; 2 1 -3| = î(6−4)−ĵ(−9−8)+k̂(3+4) = 2î+17ĵ+7k̂. Passing through (3,2,1): equation is (x−3)/2 = (y−2)/17 = (z−1)/7.

sub_questions.text: (ख) लाइन A तथा लाइन B के बीच की न्यूनतम दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Find the shortest distance between Line A and Line B.

questions.solution: Case study on Three Dimensional Geometry involving parallel lines, equations of lines, and shortest distance between skew lines. See sub-questions for answers.

questions.text: भारी गेमिंग सत्र के दौरान, एक छात्र के लैपटॉप प्रोसेसर का तापमान काफी बढ़ जाता है। सत्र के बाद में यह ठंडा होने लगता है तथा इसके ठंडा होने की दर, प्रोसेसर के तापमान तथा कमरे के तापमान (25°C) के अंतर के समानुपाती है। आरंभ में प्रोसेसर का तापमान 85°C है तथा ठंडा होने की दर समीकरण d/dt (T(t)) = − k(T(t) − 25) द्वारा परिभाषित है, जहाँ T(t), समय t (मिनट में) पर प्रोसेसर के तापमान को निरूपित करता है तथा k एक अचर है।
questions.text_english:
During a heavy gaming session, the temperature of a student's laptop processor increases significantly. After the session, the processor begins to cool down, and the rate of cooling is proportional to the difference between the processor's temperature and the room temperature (25°C). Initially the processor's temperature is 85°C. The rate of cooling is defined by the equation d/dt (T(t)) = − k(T(t) − 25), where T(t) represents the temperature of the processor at time t (in minutes) and k is a constant.

Based on the above information, answer the following questions:
(i) Find the expression for temperature of processor, T(t) given that T(0) = 85°C.
(ii) How long will it take for the processor's temperature to reach 40°C? Given that k = 0.03, logₑ 4 = 1.3863.

sub_questions.text: प्रोसेसर के तापमान T(t) के लिए व्यंजक ज्ञात कीजिए जबकि दिया गया है कि T(0) = 85°C है।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the expression for temperature of processor, T(t) given that T(0) = 85°C.
sub_questions.solution: The differential equation is dT/dt = −k(T−25). Separating variables: dT/(T−25) = −k dt. Integrating: ln|T−25| = −kt + C₁. So T−25 = Ce^(−kt). At t=0: 85−25 = C, so C = 60. Therefore T(t) = 25 + 60e^(−kt).

sub_questions.text: प्रोसेसर के तापमान को 40°C तक आने में कितना समय लगेगा ? दिया गया है कि k = 0·03, logₑ 4 = 1·3863।
sub_questions.text_english: How long will it take for the processor's temperature to reach 40°C? Given that k = 0.03, logₑ 4 = 1.3863.
sub_questions.solution: We need T(t) = 40: 25 + 60e^(−kt) = 40. So 60e^(−kt) = 15, giving e^(−kt) = 1/4. Taking natural log: −kt = −ln(4), so t = ln(4)/k = 1.3863/0.03 ≈ 46.21 minutes. The processor takes approximately 46.21 minutes to cool to 40°C.

questions.solution: Case study on differential equations using Newton's Law of Cooling. See sub-questions for detailed answers.
